ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution characterized by approximately 65% high-intensity (white/light-gray) pixels and 35% low-intensity (black/dark-gray) pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white regions occupy the central-lower portion of both lobes. These are bordered by thick, low-intensity black bands along the trailing edges and the median notch. Distinct dark vertical streaks (rake-like patterns) disrupt the white regions on both the left and right lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Calculated as a wide-angle, shallow U-shaped depression with an approximate pixel angle of 135 degrees relative to the lobe axes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular and jagged. The right lobe trailing edge features high-amplitude, low-frequency 'step' serrations. The left lobe exhibits more consistent, lower-amplitude micro-serrations. The entire boundary is non-linear with multiple distinct peaks and valleys.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Lobes exhibit a strong convex curvature on the lower leading edge, terminating in acute, upward-oriented tips (flukes). The trailing edge follows a general concave sweep toward the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast clusters of circular, textured white/gray pixels (consistent with barnacle colonization) are localized at the extreme lateral tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions are visible. Specifically, two prominent vertical parallel lines on the left lobe and several finer, scattered linear marks on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: The trailing edge shows significant irregular topography indicative of historical wear or trauma. Visible calcium-dense clusters (barnacles) are present on the lobe extremities.
other_distinctive_markers: The boundary between white and black pigmentation is highly mottled, particularly in the mid-fluke region, creating a stippled transition zone rather than a hard geometric line.
